# Anchoring overnight

A quiet anchorage needs shelter from the forecast wind, good holding ground and room to swing. Sand and mud hold well; weed and rock do not. Approach head to wind, as in [[Points of sail]].

## Scope

Let out rode at least five times the depth of the water for chain, seven times for rope. More scope in a blow keeps the anchor digging in.

## Anchor watch

Take bearings on two fixed marks ashore after the anchor sets, and set an anchor alarm on the chartplotter. If the boat drags, start the engine and re-anchor. Secure the snubber with a [[Knots for sailors#Cleat hitch|cleat hitch]].
